verdict_text:
NO

The `matrix_re` pattern omits `attention.dense.weight` from the four listed projection matrices (it only matches `query_key_value.weight`, `dense_h_to_4h.weight`, `dense_4h_to_h.weight`), so `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.dense.weight` is left in float32 instead of being cast to bfloat16, violating clause 1 of "Required result" (exactly the 64 listed projection matrices, including `attention.dense.weight`, must be bfloat16). This causes only 48 tensors to end up bfloat16 instead of 64, and the artifact's own assertion checks for `== 48`, silently accepting the wrong count instead of the required 64 specified in "Required checks".
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
